podcast.body: A 16-week number one hit for Mariah Carey and Boyz II Men, which, at the time "Uptown Funk" achieved its 14-week run, held the record for the longest continuous stay at number one in chart history, making "Uptown Funk" the second longest. "Mariah Carey and Boys to Men's 16 week number one one sweet day."

podcast.body: Released in November 1995, this duet with R&B vocal troupe Boyz II Men not only debuted at number one on the Hot 100 but also stayed there for a then-record 16 weeks. Its immense success followed the precedent set by "Fantasy" and further demonstrated Sony Music's ability to achieve unprecedented chart feats. "When her duet with R&B vocal troupe Bois to Men one sweet day dropped in November, it not only debuted at number 1, it stayed on top for a then record 16 weeks."
